description: Number of Arriving Vehicles to Makkah During Hajj by Type of Vehicle is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). Explore the dataset on the number of arriving vehicles to Makkah by type of vehicle. Analyze data related to Other industries and the Hajj pilgrimage in Saudi Arabia. Other industries, Hajj, ITEM Saudi Arabia Follow data.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research.. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are Other industries, Hajj, ITEM. The portal shows 2026-05-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
